text:
Maya Liu: Heads-up — we need a compact playbook for the upcoming regional rollout of the new routing fallback. Main asks: preserve 95th latency SLA, provide customer opt-outs, and ensure safe fallbacks.
Sam O'Connor: +1. proposal: 3-stage rollout: canary (1% global), regional ramp (10% in APAC/EU), wide (100%). canary window 6h with 15m evaluation windows.
Leila Patel: For canary metrics: latency_p95, error_rate_5m, tail_retries. kill-switch if p95 > 1.5x baseline or error_rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive windows.
Tony R.: Add per-tenant holdbacks: AF-tier accounts get opt-in only. Also need per-tenant telemetry to validate prompt-quality regressions.
Maya Liu: Flag naming conv: ff.rollout.routing_fallback.<feature>.<region>.<slice>. Example:
```
ff.rollout.routing_v2.eu.coast-1 = on
ff.rollout.routing_v2.global.canary = on
```
Sam O'Connor: Also: AB test for latency vs cost tradeoff for quantized variant. Split 50/50 inside canary cohort, evaluate generate_time and token_cost.
Leila Patel: Telemetry gating: require no new model regressions on quality evals (prompt-set A/B pass rate >= 98%). If quality drop > 1.5% we rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy started for ff.rollout.routing_v2.global.canary @channel
Maya Liu: Fallback policy: sequential fallback priority: compatible smaller model -> local cache hit -> fallback region. document order in runbook.
Tony R.: Ops checklist items: preflight (canary sample set, smoke tests), runbooks (rollback steps), oncall pagers muted to critical only, notify customers with >1M tokens/day.
Sam O'Connor: timeline: Thursday 09:00 UTC canary start — want sign-off from Product, SRE, and Support by Wed EOD.
Leila Patel: I'll add automated canary analysis script and thresholds to the flag metadata. snippet for flag metadata:
```
{
  "rollout_pct": 1,
  "duration_hours": 6,
  "metrics": ["latency_p95","error_rate"],
  "kill_conditions": {
    "latency_p95_ratio": 1.5,
    "error_rate_pct": 0.5
  }
}
```
Maya Liu: @Sam @Tony please confirm customers to notify + any legal/reg compliance checks for APAC.
Tony R.: I'll compile list, + check data residency constraints. :ok_hand: 
Sam O'Connor: LGTM from product side. will finalize playbook and add to ShipRoom.
Maya Liu: Great — final step: create per-region staging flags so we can isolate EU/APAC during rollback. please post updates in this thread. :rocket: 
deploy-bot: canary analysis complete — no alarmed thresholds. summary: latency_p95 delta +0.03x baseline, error_rate 0.12%.
Leila Patel: Nice. starting regional ramp tomorrow 09:00 UTC; will post final telemetry snapshots.
Tony R.: Noted. Oncall will monitor dashboards and set a 15m paging window for persistent errors.
Sam O'Connor: Thanks team. I'll pin the playbook doc in #product and loop in CS for customer comms.
